definitions.explanation: The act of writing books or scholarly works, or the written work itself. Formal; primarily used for books, academic writing, and the profession of writing.

examples.japanese: ⟦{父|ちち}→父：00566_chichi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{著述|ちょじゅつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧にして⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: My father makes a living by writing.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{著述|ちょじゅつ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{広|ひろ}く→広い：00704_hiroi⟧⟦{読|よ}まれている→読む：00426_yomu⟧。

⟦{長年|ながねん}→長年：09684_naganen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{研究|けんきゅう}→研究：01396_kenkyuu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{元|もと}→元：03878_moto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、{著述|ちょじゅつ}⟦{活動|かつどう}→活動：00201_katsudou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{本格的|ほんかくてき}→本格的：05681_honkakuteki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{始|はじ}めた→始める：00531_hajimeru⟧。
examples.english: Drawing on many years of research, he began writing in earnest.

notes:
Compound of {著|ちょ} (to write, to publish) + {述|じゅつ} (to state). Used as a ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ verb in {著述|ちょじゅつ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to write [a work]).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {著述|ちょじゅつ}{業|ぎょう}: the writing profession; author by trade
- {著述|ちょじゅつ}{家|か}: author; writer (of books)
- {著述|ちょじゅつ}⟦{活動|かつどう}→活動：00201_katsudou⟧: writing activity
- {著述|ちょじゅつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{重|かさ}ねる→重ねる：02039_kasaneru⟧: build up a body of writing

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{執筆|しっぴつ}→執筆：04194_shippitsu⟧: writing (the act) — focuses on the act of writing, often for a specific piece
- ⟦{著作|ちょさく}→著作：18234_chosaku⟧: written work — emphasizes the work as a product; basis of ⟦{著作権|ちょさくけん}→著作権：14022_chosakuken⟧ (copyright)
- ⟦{作品|さくひん}→作品：02776_sakuhin⟧: work — general term for any creative work, not specific to writing
